Findings triage (first grade): **HOLD** — `finding` stays.

- **Premise re-verified** @ `origin/main` `6044d13`: the drift is real and current — `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx:123` still cites "the same unreachability `createdRecordPath.ts` documents for `resolveHostAppSegment`", while PR #4318 (merged, `e4d1c08`) made `createdRecordPath.ts` import the resolver from the package root (`:57` `import { resolveHostAppSegment } from '@object-ui/app-shell'`). The surviving half of the comment also still holds: app-shell's root barrel exports no `./urlParams`, so the literal remains justified.
- **Why hold**: one clause, comment-only, zero behaviour, zero tests. Dispatching it standalone spends a claim + PR + CI cycle on a single sentence — the wrong fixed-cost ratio while the fix has a natural carrier.
- **Restart conditions**: ① the next PR touching `FormPage.tsx` — the dispatch order should name this card as a declared out-of-surface add-on (the fenced #4280 dev correctly filed instead of touching); ② a comment-hygiene sweep batch in this repo, where this joins as one line of N (the stale-cross-reference family: #3367 / #3842 one level down, as the card notes).
- **Dedup**: no other card covers this clause; #4280/#4318 are the cause, not an overlap.

**Keep the true half, drop the borrowed witness.** The comment's own claim still holds — app-shell's root barrel still does not re-export `./urlParams`, so the literal is still justified. What expired is the cross-reference: PR #4318 published `resolveHostAppSegment` from the package root and deleted the console's local subset, so `createdRecordPath.ts` documents no such unreachability any more; it imports the resolver. Point at the `./urlParams` fact directly instead of borrowing a sibling's now-resolved case.

**Verify both halves before writing.** Confirm on current `origin/main` that (a) the root barrel still omits `./urlParams`, and (b) `createdRecordPath.ts` now imports `resolveHostAppSegment` from `@object-ui/app-shell`. If (a) has changed, the literal itself may no longer be justified and this stops being a comment fix — **stop and report** rather than repairing prose around a premise that moved.

**Note on the timing.** This card's hold said its restart condition was "the next PR touching `FormPage.tsx`". That fired: this seat landed #5597 against that file earlier today. Dispatching it now rather than waiting for another carrier.

Prose only — no behaviour, no tests. If your diff touches anything that emits JavaScript, stop and report.
